code_quality.rationale: Clean separation of concerns, clear comments explaining non-obvious invariants (e.g., why timeoutMs is excluded from selection keys), and idiomatic TypeScript.

intervention_impact.rationale: Zero interventions recorded across all categories (review_comment, test_fix, post_pr_commit, manual_edit, session_redirect all 0).

expansion.rationale: The task packet precisely named the files to touch, the invariant to preserve (HOK-3101 single-primitive rule), the constraint set (no new stop reasons, keep per-call timeouts), and detailed validation steps with edge cases, which maps closely to what was implemented.
